description: Reederey87's two-DGX-Spark vLLM TP2 kit (main 4ccddc88, 2026-09-13, no release tag) for LibertAI's REAP-256E pruning of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (snapshot 76ced425): routed experts pruned 384 to 256 per layer, nothing re-quantized (experts MXFP4, dense layers FP8), 385.5 GiB in all of which the 189 GiB Engram tables are streamed from disk. The REAP repository ships 46 of 48 shards; the two Engram shards (47 and 48) are the official checkpoint's, selected from its Model, so each Spark holds the full 414 GB tree. Built on the digest-pinned linux/arm64 vllm/vllm-openai:deepseekv41-flash-0909 image (the day-0 V4.1 image) with upstream's four kernel-contract patches applied byte-identically at build: 64-token SWA pages, a 32-state compressed-page prefill instantiation in FlashInfer's sparse-MLA kernel (the stock AOT binary is masked, the patched module is compiled at image build, offline, with MAX_JOBS=2, and installed in FlashInfer's AOT slot, so the engine loads it directly: no nvcc runs beside the engine and nothing is written to the read-only image; if the binary ever failed to load, FlashInfer would warn and compile into the writable cache), a 64-token kernel block for the V4.1 sparse backends, and a Triton FP8 paged-MQA logits fallback. The Engram overlay skips the tables while loading and gathers rows with buffered POSIX pread from the mounted shards: no io_uring, no Direct I/O, no CUDA mmap, and the tables are not memory use. Upstream defaults: 65,536-token window, two sessions, 4 GiB fp8 KV pool (841,973 tokens), eager execution (CUDA graphs produce NaN on this checkpoint), text only (the vision tower is switched off), speculation off by default as upstream ships it (DSpark with 5 draft tokens and the greedy draft sampler is an option), 0.82 GPU memory utilization, prefix caching, 4096-token long-prefill threshold, vLLM's deepseek_v41 tool and reasoning parsers. Upstream claims (measured on its own two Sparks, not measured here): 25.65 tok/s single-stream decode with DSpark against 13.16 without, needle recall to 64,851 prompt tokens. Pruning costs quality: the publisher measured +14.1% text and +8.9% caption perplexity against the unpruned model, and no downstream benchmark has been run. Memory is an estimate: about 105 GB of weights per rank plus the 4.29 GB KV pool and the 8 GB runtime overhead; upstream keeps a 90 GiB free-memory floor and warns that the node hard-resets as MemAvailable approaches zero. Licences are information only: the kit's own tooling is MIT (its LICENSE; GitHub shows NOASSERTION for the repository), the weights are MIT, vLLM and FlashInfer Apache-2.0. Not carried: the SSH launcher, host preflights and per-node FlashInfer prebuild, and upstream's build-time test suites. Vonk physical acceptance is pending.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash REAP 256E Reederey87 vLLM two Sparks
